floorPlans.label: Emaar: Aurea full floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore complete one-, two- and three-bedroom apartment sheets, including the larger terrace variants. Each original page retains the drawing, floor and unit references, area breakdown, key plan, building section and developer notices.
floorPlans.note: Totals include balcony or terrace areas, not just the internal suite. Repeated types can change with the floor or unit, so their original sheets remain separate. The three-bedroom Type A4 includes 1,033.55 sq ft of outdoor space within its total. Small differences of 0.01 sq ft can arise from rounded components. Confirm the signed unit plan and specifications with Emaar.
